summary.en: What has to happen, happens, Conan receives a call from Yumi and is informed about the crime scene, the suspect's testimony, Conan also asks her some small questions about the victim and is immediately answered with the crime scene recording at that time. And with the selfie of the group of 4 people, Conan also realizes the truth of the case. However, suddenly before that, Yumi suddenly saw the heart symbol on the 7th of this month in Kobayashi's notebook when they were looking for Agasa's number to send the security tape, from there they decided to solve this case without Conan. But are the two people's deductions similar?
